protocol_notice: Original matrix and frozen-protocol metadata retained as a historical record, not current release requirements. Current release calibration uses representative public-source gates; scripts.run_unit_cycle_campaign runs the complete matrix with declared finite effect grids, summable checkpoint error spending, and retained incomplete outcomes. See docs/guides/switchback.md.
task: I14 independent unit-cycle design; prospective and unexecuted
enumeration: Full Cartesian product in axis_order; last axis varies fastest; no cell exclusions

law.order: Independent Bernoulli(probability_ct) per unit-cycle, independent of type and all potential errors
law.unit_type: Independent equiprobable -1/+1; all cycles of a unit share the type
law.counts: equal=2; unequal=1+2*((cycle+period+(type>0)) mod 2); fixed before orders
law.noise: Unit reuse selector Bernoulli(rho): common treatment innovation if selected, otherwise independent micro-observation innovations. Each innovation has exact named centered unit-variance marginal; an aggregate is explicitly a sum/mean, not the original marginal.
law.covariance: Distinct treatment micro-errors in a unit have covariance rho; independent units; zero control errors. Aggregated period covariance rho*load_j*load_k. Conditional non-reuse variance load_j^2/count_j.
law.missingness: None. Counts are micro-observations aggregated into complete schedule cells, not missing rows.
law.truth: Population mean-unit retained effect delta, independent of production; fixed schedules enumerate all order assignments separately
law.carryover: I14 base true=declared=0; C12 full true x declared {0,1,2} x {0,1,2} for BOTH laws remains separate and required
law.weak_null: Average population treatment effect zero with heterogeneous unit, period and cycle effects; sharp-null permutations cannot certify it

inferential_resampling: None. Reserved inference seed remains unused.
rng: PCG64; SeedSequence([dgp_seed, cell_index, stream]); streams order=0,type=1,noise=2,reuse=3
batch_rule: min(512, max(1, 240000 // (units*cycles*6))) experiments; no outcome-dependent batching
family_allocation: Reserved .001 slice of release .01 budget; not a reset of R03 global eta
gated_statistics: analytic returned-point bias plus empirical accounting
coverage_gate: CP lower >= .945 in all lanes including MDE
availability_gate: CP lower >= .99 in all lanes including MDE
planning_agreement_gate: Total planning and runtime margin <= .0025; entire difference interval inside +/-.005
power_witness: N40/C1/p.5/V0=1/delta1 normal; exact normal envelope power >=.90; production CP lower >=.80
failure_accounting: R,P,I,H,excluded,failed; interval reasons distinct from failures; conditional H/I and unconditional H/R; null when denominator zero; every exception/code and all-same-order event counted; no redraw
public_path_parity: All cells source/stats/estimate/evidence/planning metadata/frame/wire parity. Confirmation calls public estimator for every attempt.

response_meaning_scope.retained_total: Micro-observation totals supplied as complete retained period cells; mean units and cycles, not pooled observations
response_meaning_scope.pre_normalized_retained_mean: Micro-observation means normalized before source ingress; mean units and cycles, not a new source weighting selector
response_meaning_scope.limitation: Distinct response meanings and potential outcomes; no micro-count or second weighting selector enters runtime. Unequal retained schedule rows remain unsupported.

repetitions: Derived by terminal binomial passing-set sizing; no integer repetitions frozen before execution
analytic_evidence: 4320 cells: exact rational moments, residual variance, actual admission mask mass, positive slopes, unconditional coverage, finite width, admitted-point bias
mde_design: 2160 designs; simultaneous DKW exploratory search, frozen candidate, independent fixed-effect planning and runtime confirmation; no fallback effect
bias_accounting: Analytic admitted-point standardized bias bound <= .05 and actual returned-point mean/MCSE in every lane
directional_allocation: 2160*(2 independent exploratory DKW + 8 production search DKW + 24 fixed-effect planning DKW + 15 runtime CP)+5 witness=105845; certificate replay shares the production search bands and adds computation, not another allocation
nominal_failure_allocation: Main supplies nominal reservation; half covers terminal count-set failures over 2160*15+5 gates, half covers all simultaneous MC-band failures. eta=min(.001/105845,nominal/(2*105845)); zeta=nominal/(2*32405). MDE passing set reserves reference-band width within the unchanged .005 tolerance.
confirmation_seed: Original SeedSequence([dgp_seed, original_cell_index, stream]) for BOTH declared-effect rows. Shared MDE lane reuses zero-effect-row primitives. All four original streams are retained.
planning_seed: Independent exploration namespace [dgp_seed, original_index, 14000, stream]; production search seed namespace 14001; fixed-effect planning namespace 14002+lane; never selected after outcomes

cost_ceiling.meaning: Operational cap on the full prospective maximum, including certificate replay; not a scientific tolerance or permission to truncate trials. Exceeding it leaves release certification incomplete.

certification_artifacts: make test-all requires tests/unit_cycle_frozen_sizing.json and executes all required evidence tests; missing sizing fails, without environment opt-ins. Per-test evidence is retained in pytest tmp_path and recorded in JUnit properties.
